name: HELLO
description: Open flat palm facing camera with fingers together upright (static wave/salute pose).

name: YES
description: Closed fist with thumb pointing upright (thumbs-up pose).

name: NO
description: Closed fist with thumb pointing down (thumbs-down pose).

name: THANK YOU
description: Flat open hand with fingers pointing upward near chest (static appreciation pose).

name: PLEASE
description: Open hand with palm facing inward towards chest flat.

name: HELP
description: Thumbs-up hand held resting directly above open flat palm.

name: SORRY
description: Closed fist held over chest (static key-pose approximation).

name: STOP
description: Open vertical palm facing directly forward with spread fingers.

name: GOOD
description: Index finger touching tip of thumb forming an O-shape (OK sign).

name: LOVE
description: Thumb, index finger, and pinky extended upward; middle and ring folded.
